docs.summary: Toast notification system for Origami. Manages the toast queue internally. Use the fluent builder returned by [`Toast`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~Toast) to fire toasts. Call [`Draw`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Toasts~Draw) once per frame from the host's render loop.
Set toast to Error style (default 5s duration).
Fire the toast notification. An identical toast already on screen is moved to the front and its counter bumped instead.
